summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizes the importance of reliable broadband for modern education.

claims.requested_action: Preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program
claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would increase operational costs for school districts
claims.evidence_quote: Mount Vernon Twp H S Dist 201 has received $325,295 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $65,059 a year toward the connections our students depend on.

filer_raw: Mt. Vernon Township High School District 201
